meta.name: NFHS-5 (2019-21) district fact sheet indicators
meta.source_org: International Institute for Population Sciences (IIPS) and Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, India
meta.license: Official fact sheets: Government of India data. Parsed CSV mirror: MIT (jvargh7/nfhs5_factsheets).
meta.limitations: Values come from a community parse of the official PDF fact sheets and can have parse errors. Districts are the NFHS-5 (2019-21) districts; districts created later have no row. The 11 Delhi districts and Mumbai Suburban do not match districts2020.csv and are left out; Mumbai may cover only the island city. Chandigarh and Lakshadweep have no district fact sheet. Values with fewer than 25 cases are null; values from 25-49 cases are kept without a flag.
meta.method: Read the mirror CSV, keep the selected indicators by their NFHS fact-sheet number, convert NA to null, map state and district names to districts2020.csv with an explicit alias table in pipeline/build_health.py. No numbers are changed.
meta.redistributed_via: https://github.com/jvargh7/nfhs5_factsheets (rchiips.org not used; cross-checked against pratapvardhan/NFHS-5 for the states it covers)
